summary.final_text:
The dilution series is in `assay_plate` wells A1–A4, with 100 µL in each well. I did not mix the wells, because the liquid handler has no mix command; the dispenses were made straight into PBS.

| Well | BSA standard (2 mg/mL stock) | PBS | Final concentration |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | 100 µL | 0 µL | 2 mg/mL |
| A2 | 50 µL | 50 µL | 1 mg/mL |
| A3 | 25 µL | 75 µL | 0.5 mg/mL |
| A4 | 12.5 µL | 87.5 µL | 0.25 mg/mL |

I made each well by diluting the 2 mg/mL stock directly, not by transferring from well to well. A serial transfer would have left A2–A4 with less than 100 µL each. The stock volumes are a 1:2 series, so the concentrations match your request.

Stock volumes afterwards: BSA standard in reagents:A2 is 9812.5 µL (187.5 µL used), and PBS in reagents:A1 is 39787.5 µL (212.5 µL used). I used a fresh tip for each source and dropped each tip empty. I did not read the plate.

task_def.source: Two-fold serial dilution of a BSA standard, the usual way protein-assay standard curves are built (compare the diluted-standards table in the Thermo Scientific Pierce BCA Protein Assay user guide, MAN0011430, which also starts from 2 mg/mL BSA).
task_def.prompt: Make a two-fold serial dilution of the BSA standard across assay_plate wells A1 to A4, so that A1 is 2 mg/mL, A2 is 1 mg/mL, A3 is 0.5 mg/mL and A4 is 0.25 mg/mL, with 100 uL in each well. Dilute with PBS buffer.
